string.value:

string.name: teaching_title
string.value: Master the solve, step by step

string.name: teaching_description
string.value: Start from a set position, choose your own route, and solve all six faces.

string.name: teaching_rules
string.value: Solve all six faces so each is one color, using any route. References count 90° quarter turns, not a minimum; there is no move or time limit. Progress is saved separately from regular timed results.

string.name: teaching_goal
string.value: Goal: make each of the six faces one solid color.

string.name: teaching_start_hint
string.value: Your first swipe to turn a layer starts the timer. Solve any way you choose.

string.name: teaching_retry_message
string.value: Return to the same starting position and clear the timer and move count. This does not solve the cube. Saved learning progress is kept.

string.name: teaching_leave_message
string.value: This unfinished position will not be saved. Saved learning progress is kept.

string.name: teaching_all_complete
string.value: This level is complete. Return to explore other positions.

string.name: teaching_save_failed
string.value: Level complete, but learning progress could not be saved.

string.name: teaching_previous_save_failed
string.value: The previous learning progress could not be saved.

string.name: teaching_hint_note
string.value: Solve hints retrace this attempt’s move history and may not be the shortest solution. Requesting a hint counts as assistance and marks this attempt as solved with hints when completed.

string.name: teaching_completed_note
string.value: Only learning progress is recorded, not regular timed results.

string.name: teaching_history_hint
string.value: Solve reference: %1$s. Follow the hand with a swipe along its path, then release to turn the layer. Rotate the view if the hand is hidden. This attempt will be marked as solved with hints when completed.

string.name: teaching_first_turn_description
string.value: See how a right-layer turn changes the 2×2 colors, and practice returning the corners to their places.

string.name: teaching_first_turn_tip
string.value: Compare the color bands on neighboring faces to find the layer that needs turning back. Check more than the face in front.

string.name: teaching_corner_pair_description
string.value: The 2×2 right and top layers have turned in succession. Practice tracking how one turn affects the next.

string.name: teaching_corner_pair_tip
string.value: Keep one corner's three colors in mind. Watch how it moves between neighboring layers before choosing your next turn.

string.name: teaching_corner_loop_description
string.value: Back-and-forth right and top turns have displaced the 2×2 corners. Practice checking both position and orientation.

string.name: teaching_corner_loop_tip
string.value: Identify each corner by its color combination, then check its orientation. Colors separated for a moment can meet again in later turns.

string.name: teaching_last_layer_description
string.value: The 3×3 bottom two layers are solved, but the top layer is offset. Practice aligning the top rows of the side faces.

string.name: teaching_last_layer_tip
string.value: A solid-color top is not enough. Look around all four sides and check that each top row matches the colors below.

string.name: teaching_right_slot_description
string.value: The 3×3 right slot and top layer need restoring. Practice tracking a corner together with its neighboring edge.

string.name: teaching_right_slot_tip
string.value: Find the target corner's three colors and locate its place, then check the neighboring edge. Look again after each turn.

string.name: teaching_cross_return_description
string.value: The 3×3 bottom two layers are solved. Two neighboring top edges face upward in an L shape. Practice recognizing edge orientation.

string.name: teaching_cross_return_tip
string.value: First check which top edges face upward, then check their side colors. A cross is only part of the goal: all six faces must be solved.

string.name: teaching_corner_orient_description
string.value: The 3×3 bottom two layers are solved and the top edges are oriented, but only one top corner faces upward. Check top-layer positions as well as orientation.

string.name: teaching_corner_orient_tip
string.value: A corner facing the right way may still be in the wrong place. Top edges may also be misplaced, so rotate the view to check side colors.

string.name: teaching_edge_cycle_description
string.value: The 3×3 top corners are solved, while three top edges are cycled out of place. Practice identifying each edge's destination.

string.name: teaching_edge_cycle_tip
string.value: Use the side colors to trace the three edges' destinations and their cycle. Make sure the solved top corners are still correct at the end.

string.name: no_results_help
string.value:
Scramble and solve the cube
to set your first record.

string.name: results_retention
string.value:
Only the latest 200 results are kept on this device.
Tutorials and sessions using solve hints do not count.

string.name: beginner_guides_help
string.value:
Follow the corner gestures; release to turn.
Hands and faint swipe paths appear only at visible corners.
Middle pieces work too. These guides do not solve the cube.

string.name: turn_sound_help
string.value: Hear each turn click into place

string.name: about_description
string.value: A lightweight 3D cube, ready anytime. All calculations and results stay on your device. No ads or internet required.
